purpose: Bounded finite measured tests requested by M6 Pass C (+Fierce Guardianship vs Sheoldred's Edict / Nightscape Familiar; +Soul's Fire vs Sheoldred's Edict / Muddle the Mixture; Dress Down + Kediss + Phyresis layer case; Distortion Strike vs Rogue's Passage) plus the deployment cost of the selected swaps. Seeded goldfish deployment model and exhaustive rules-encoded scenario grids; not a game simulation, not a source-bound game-engine receipt and not a win rate.

results.partA_method: Seeded finite Monte Carlo goldfish of deployment only. One land per turn (tapped lands preferred on turns 1-2, untapped afterwards; Arena of Glory untapped with a Mountain-typed land; fetches resolved to an on-colour typed dual; Exotic Orchard / Fellwar Stone treated as any colour; Cavern of Souls (Zombie) gives any colour only to Zombie creature spells, Lord included). Torpor Orb / Karn cast first; Lord of Tresserhorn cast only when safe: a suppressor on the battlefield, or at least two other creatures/tokens to sacrifice (Bitterblossom tokens, Ophiomancer snake), or Stifle / Tale's End / Dress Down held with its mana after paying Lord; Nightscape Familiar reduces Lord by one generic. Then rocks, then creatures cheapest first (MV>3 creatures held until Lord is out from turn 3). Skullclamp equips cost 1 and kill a toughness-1 body (keeping two bodies until Lord is out), drawing two. Conversion card = Phyresis, Tainted Strike, Uncaged Fury, Temur Battle Rage, Chandra's Ignition, Pain for All, Soul's Fire or Kediss in hand or on the battlefield. No opponent, no blockers, no removal, no tutors, no Treasures, no Mystic Remora draws (conservative).
results.partB_method: Exhaustive finite rules-encoded grids: B1 evasion (Cover of Darkness vs Aqueous Form over blocker types x Lord original/recast); B2 conversion (Pain for All vs Temur Battle Rage vs Soul's Fire over infect none/Phyresis/Tainted Strike x 0/1/2 chump blockers x +1 power source x spare mana 0..5 x opponent life 40/20/10 x instant removal on Lord in response); B3 interaction (Sheoldred's Edict vs Soul's Fire over target kinds x Lord present/absent); B4 protection (Nightscape Familiar vs Fierce Guardianship over threat kinds x mana); B5 Pass C Dress Down layer-6 truth table. Manually encoded rules branches, not source-bound game-engine receipts and not win rates.

B1_evasion_Cover_vs_Aqueous.notes: Shizo, Death's Storehouse ({B},{T}: target legendary creature gains fear) duplicates Cover of Darkness for Lord when available. Lord is black, so fear (Cover of Darkness, also Shizo) is stopped by any black or artifact blocker; Aqueous Form is stopped only if the aura leaves with Lord (recast copies are unenchanted). Cover also gives fear to other Zombies (not counted: the kill plan is Lord).

B2_conversion_Pain_vs_TBR_vs_SoulsFire.notes: One opponent; Pain for All modelled for its enters trigger (precombat, sorcery-speed aura); its later reflection clause (needs damage dealt to Lord, e.g. Blasphemous Act / Goblin Bombardment) is the disclosed loss and not in this grid. Soul's Fire is an instant (castable after blockers or in response); TBR trample assumes ferocious (Lord itself has power 10). Commander damage threshold 21; poison 10.

B3_interaction_Edict_vs_kept_suite_and_S.notes: Sheoldred's Edict modes: creature / nontoken creature / creature token / planeswalker (each opponent sacrifices; the opponent picks within the mode). Kept spot removal after the swap: Terminate, Deadly Rollick, Chaos Warp, Feed the Swarm; sweepers Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act. Soul's Fire (rejected challenger) needs Lord on the battlefield for 10 damage. Cells where Edict alone answers are the disclosed loss of +Skullclamp -Sheoldred's Edict.

B4_protection_StubbornDenial_vs_FierceGu.notes: Both counter only noncreature spells. Fierce Guardianship is free while you control a commander; Stubborn Denial costs {U} and is a hard counter only with ferocious (Lord itself, power 10). With no ferocious the opponent is assumed able to pay {1}. Lord on the stack does not count as controlled for either.

B5_Dress_Down_layer6_truth_table.notes: Dress Down: creatures lose all abilities (layer 6). Ability-granting effects with a later timestamp than Dress Down still apply (CR 613.7: an Aura/Equipment's timestamp is when it became attached; a resolved instant's effect gets its own timestamp). So Phyresis attached before Dress Down is overridden; Phyresis cast/attached after it or Tainted Strike after it grant infect. Anger's graveyard static haste and Greaves equipped earlier are overridden; re-equipping Greaves ({0}) after Dress Down restores haste. Kediss is itself a creature, so its trigger is gone while Dress Down is on the battlefield (Dress Down is sacrificed at the end step). Lord's own {B} regeneration is also gone that turn.
